reviews.text: The waiting time is far too long, and I think it's causing a lot of stress for dogs and cats. They're also holding in their bladder and toilet needs during that time, so if you receive an email saying they'll be seen in about 20 minutes, I'd like them to be seen and paid for within an hour.

The wait time is way too long! Let me do the blood test first!!!! The doctor didn't even show his face!!!! The wait time went from zero to over an hour!? I wonder if they think it's okay if the number of patients increases. There was a petite limmer there today, waiting in the waiting room for an examination for illness or injury, and the customers who came for a shampoo might be important too, but they were making way too much noise!! They've done the same thing over and over!!

I've been a patient here for about six months.

The doctor is always thorough and trustworthy, but the receptionist's attitude is disappointing every time.

Their answers to questions are vague, and their response is slow.

Even with an appointment, it always takes about two hours by the time I finish paying. Is this because there's only one person handling reception and payment for the number of patients?

I think many patients would appreciate it if this could be improved.

My 5-year-old Maltese had bloody stools for the first time, and since our regular vet was closed, I was in a bind. I called this clinic, and they kindly saw us in the evening, even though it was our first visit. Thank you so much for your kind and thorough response over the phone despite your busy schedule.

I am truly grateful to Dr. Yada for examining our dog, for explaining everything so carefully, and for the smooth and efficient testing. 🙇‍♂️
I also appreciate the advice on future preventative measures.

Thanks to you, our dog's stools improved the very next day, and he's completely recovered!

I was also grateful that we could use our insurance at the counter, which was a great relief financially.

Thank you very much.

Dear Maa Y,
Thank you so much for your kind review.
It's a great encouragement to all of our staff.
Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any further questions or concerns.
Like everyone else who's posted, I have to wait several hours after calling the app. This is completely pointless. It's really tiring.

My pet tree frog accidentally ingested some substrate, and Dr. Hayashi performed abdominal surgery to remove the sand.

Now it's completely recovered and healthy.

Thank you so much.

I'm so glad it was a hospital that could treat exotic animals.
I made a reservation through the app. When I got there, I was made to wait for over an hour and a half. What's the point of a reservation then?! 💢 …

Dear Mr. Tomonori Takada

Thank you very much for your kind review.

It is a great encouragement to all of our staff.

Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any further questions or concerns.

We've been going to this animal hospital since September of last year. My dog's ear infection and pancreatitis, which wouldn't heal at our previous hospital, have finally cleared up thanks to their care. The head veterinarian and staff are incredibly kind, showing us the results of the ear treatment and explaining the examination clearly. We visited for an afternoon/night appointment on June 23rd, 2026, around 8:30 PM. The night doctor was quick and explained that everything was fine, which put both my dog ​​and us at ease. The doctors are so quick to treat patients both in the morning and at night; it's truly a wonderful hospital. Thank you so much for today.

There are few hospitals that treat reptiles, so I am very grateful to be able to get a thorough examination here, but I think something should be done about the waiting time. The waiting room is kept at a low temperature due to the air conditioning, and waiting for a long time is quite stressful for a reptile like a bearded dragon. Taking this into consideration, I made an appointment with another doctor who was available instead of the head doctor, checked in on the app when it was my turn, and arrived with a waiting time of 0 minutes. However, I was called into the examination room two hours later. Losing patience, I told the reception that I had been waiting for almost two hours, and was told that they couldn't call me because the examination room wasn't available, and that they would call me next. There were several times when the examination room became available after I arrived, and people who came after me were called in one after another and left before me. I don't know how the doctors and nurses are working inside, but it defeats the purpose of making an appointment. I even think that waiting for a long time in a cold waiting room when you're going to the hospital because you're feeling unwell might make your condition worse. In the end, even though my husband took over partway through, our sick bearded dragon was only able to return home 4.5 hours after arriving at the hospital. I think the waiting times and appointment system need to be reviewed.


The quality of the examination and the thoroughness of the staff were truly helpful. Please consider the star rating as a reflection of the waiting time (especially the app's system).

A place I always rely on 🐈🐈
————————————————————————
Updated 2026.08.01

I've been going to this hospital for about 1-2 years now.

First of all, I think the doctor's examinations and treatment are very thorough and trustworthy. On one occasion, when my cat was being unruly and the examination was difficult, they considered the situation and prescribed medication only, for which I am very grateful.

However, I feel that the reception and operational aspects have deteriorated considerably over the past year or so.

Previously, they would dispense medication on the same day, but now it's necessary to make a phone reservation by the day before. I understand that the number of patients has increased, and I don't have any complaints about the rule itself.

The problem is that even though they are following the rule, the operation is completely dysfunctional.

This time, I called the day before to request medication preparation, and only planned to pick it up and pay on the day. Despite this, I was told "Please wait a moment" at the reception, and ended up waiting for about an hour.

I cannot understand why I had to wait an hour just to pay, even though I had requested the medication in advance and there was no consultation. Something similar happened before, but I understood it then because it was a same-day request. However, this time, I felt there was clearly no improvement.

Furthermore, I am concerned about the reception staff's attitude.

This time, too, a person who appeared to be a first-time visitor didn't understand the registration process (QR code registration) and was waiting at their seat. Even after the reception staff returned, they didn't notice the person waiting for a while, resulting in that person also having to wait for a long time.

Moreover, although I believe this reception staff member has been working there for some time, I have the impression that they frequently say, "Let me check. Please wait a moment," and then consult with other staff members when asked questions.

When I called the day before to request "anti-diarrhea, anti-nausea, and gastrointestinal medication," I was asked, "Do you know the names of the medications?" However, the hospital should have a record of past prescriptions in their medical records, so I think it's unreasonable to assume that the pet owner would remember the brand names of the medications.

I still trust the doctor, but the inefficiency of the reception, accounting, and overall operations makes me reconsider continuing to bring my pet there.

I fully understand that the clinic is busy with many patients. However, making me wait an hour just for accounting doesn't show respect for the owner's time.

It's a real shame, especially since the doctor is so good. I hope they will improve their reception system and workflow.

Dear Shima Suzuki,
Thank you so much for your kind review.
It's a great encouragement to all of our staff.
Please feel free to contact us anytime if you have any further questions or concerns.

The head veterinarian saved my cat. I shudder to think what would have happened if I had continued going to another clinic.

However, the waiting times are terrible.

It varies from day to day, but I've waited an hour with no one else waiting.

Don't trust the waiting times on PetPass.

While waiting times are unavoidable in a hospital setting, and I understand everyone works without breaks, this waiting time must be tough for pets.

Also, after 8 PM, the reception area gets crowded with people seeking after-hours care.

It's a hassle every time, but even considering all that, I think it's a hospital worth going to.

Being able to book appointments online and get an estimate of the consultation time is very helpful. The doctor and staff are all very kind, which puts me at ease. The clinic is very clean and tidy. There is a paid parking lot, and you get a parking ticket for one hour. There is also one dedicated parking space (free). Recently, they have started offering evening appointments as well.

I made a reservation through the app, and an alarm came 20 minutes before my appointment, with only one person ahead of me. However, when I arrived, I was made to wait for an hour and a half.

Even when I asked the receptionist, the response was vague.

When I asked the doctor, he said there was no skipping of the line, but there were more people undergoing tests...

Even when I explained that there was only one person ahead of me, they didn't seem to understand.

The nearby Yamairi Animal Hospital was better.

I think it's a very good hospital, but if you request the head doctor, the waiting time will be quite long. Therefore, if you're only getting preventative care or something minor, I recommend requesting a different doctor.

The other younger doctors are also very kind and helpful, and you can ask the head doctor for their opinion on any concerns, so you can feel at ease.

Dear Hoi Hoi,
Thank you for taking the time to provide us with your feedback.

We sincerely acknowledge that we were not able to provide you with a completely satisfactory experience this time, and all of our staff will strive to ensure that you feel even more at ease when you visit our clinic in the future.

As other reviewers have mentioned, the waiting time is extremely long, and it seems that people who arrive later and present their appointment cards are seen first. When I made my online reservation, it showed there were two groups ahead of me, but four more groups went in while I was waiting. Long waiting times are incredibly stressful for animals who strongly dislike going to the vet.

The doctors explain things clearly, and it's easy to ask about costs and other things at this hospital.
However, it gets incredibly crowded.
I think one of the reasons for the crowds is that many people come with two (or occasionally three) people for every one animal, so I wish they would start limiting the number of accompanying persons for animals other than large ones.

[Addendum]
When I visited on April 21, 2026, they had posted a notice and put up a notice on PetPASS stating, "Please limit the number of accompanying persons for pets to two or fewer (excluding infants)."

I had my toad examined. I was happy that they handled the animal gently.

It's a bit of a distance from my home, but it's close to the station, so it's easy to get to by train.

There aren't many places that properly care for amphibians, so I was grateful.

However, the waiting time is far too long. I waited for over two and a half hours.

Exotic animals can be stressful with long waiting times, so I wish they would improve their reservation system. PetPass is convenient, but it's still so long.

I wish they would offer something like online reservations.

It's wonderful that they have multiple veterinarians on staff, allowing them to provide consultations even during times when other animal hospitals are often closed, such as on weekend afternoons.

They also seem to treat some exotic animals.

I had just moved and was looking for a new veterinary clinic. This one was conveniently located on my commute route. Plus, I could make an appointment, which was great because it was less stressful for my cat.
However, my cat was a bit scared being in the waiting room with all the other pets.
Dr. Hayashi was incredibly thorough!
I can't comment on the other doctors since it was my first visit, but he repeatedly asked me if I had any other questions, as I'm a first-time cat owner, and explained everything each time.
I highly recommend it.
I visited for night-time medical care. The staff were very kind and helpful.
This is a veterinary hospital where small animals can also be examined.

Our dog was diagnosed with congenital patellar luxation at 5 months old. At 7 months old, his condition worsened, and his weight was only 1.5 kg. We were worried whether he could withstand general anesthesia, but he wouldn't eat, so we decided to go ahead with the surgery. In the end, he had surgery on both legs, one month apart. The staff took great care of him during his hospital stay. Thanks to them, he is now running around happily. The doctor is humble, yet his diagnosis is excellent, and he answers all our anxieties without showing any displeasure. It is certainly crowded, but we don't mind because we want to be sure that our dog will be seen. We are so glad we entrusted our dog to this clinic. We look forward to continuing to use their services in the future.

I'm always grateful for the care I receive from you. It's been really hot lately, and my cat is pretty heavy, so it's been hard to go to the hospital, but today I decided to use the free shuttle service. It's truly a genius service!! The staff are also very kind. I'm really impressed with the hospital's service. I look forward to continuing to use your services. 🙇‍♀️

Dr. Murai treats my elderly cat with kidney problems, and he always sincerely accepts any changes in his condition and does everything he can to help improve it. Without his treatment, he would have died, so I am extremely grateful. The staff, despite being young, also worked hard. I'm sure they are busy as it's a popular store, but I hope they continue to do their best!
They were very kind and polite, and I am grateful that they even examined me during the Obon holidays.

My cat had a loss of appetite. I had tartar removed and teeth extracted on separate days, but they only removed the minimum necessary, so he remained healthy and his appetite returned within a few days. His bad breath has also improved significantly. I'm very grateful.

The doctor has a great personality, is knowledgeable, and examines my dog ​​thoroughly.
He senses my concerns and explains them in detail, so this is the most comfortable vet I've ever been to in all the years I've lived with several dogs.
I don't think the fees are expensive either.
I think they're within the realm of average.
(In fact, there are sometimes discounted health checkups during certain times of the year with promotions.)
If you make a reservation through the app and show up as scheduled, the wait isn't that long.
On weekends and holidays, it can take a while if you request the director, but there are other doctors available, so if you're in a hurry for a simple procedure, you can probably get the appointment done fairly quickly if you request someone other than the director.
I get the impression that the hospital is trying to think about things like wait times from the patient's perspective, so it's up to the users to use the system effectively.

Personally, I think a busy vet is one hint as to whether they're trustworthy, so I try to be tolerant of that.
A vet with zero wait time would actually be scary 😂

I called outside of opening hours for an emergency and they were happy to accommodate me and examined me carefully. 
Thank you very much. 
I've been coming here for a chronic illness for some time, and it's my favorite of all the hospitals I've been to.
The vet is young but experienced and trustworthy. We use their services for our exotic animals. You can make reservations through their pet app, so you can get a rough idea of ​​the waiting time.

The wait time was way too long.

I waited for two and a half hours.

It wasn't moving at all.

I had made a reservation through the app, but because of traffic, I was going to arrive a few minutes late for my appointment. When I called beforehand, they said they couldn't see me, so I couldn't get an appointment.

This is a terrible hospital; they only care about making money. The consultation fee is also way too expensive.

I am always grateful for the doctor's care. Even when busy, he listens carefully to what I have to say, and I feel at ease entrusting my care to him. However, the only disappointing thing is the attitude of the receptionist who has been there since the clinic opened. She is always rude and unfriendly, and the smiling face in the photo on the website is a lie. I can't believe it, but judging from her name tag, is she a family member or something...? It ruins the good reputation of the hospital and the doctor, so I think it should be improved as soon as possible. The receptionist who seems to have recently started working here has a lovely smile.

I visited for a hamster's checkup.

I made a reservation online, but at that time, the wait was 230 minutes.

I made the reservation for around 3 PM, and my turn came around 7 PM, but I called to let them know I would be late.

I went by car, and I was able to park in the adjacent parking lot.

One of the lots seems to belong to Murai Animal Hospital, and as expected, there were cars parked there.

However, if you present your parking receipt, you can get a 200 yen discount.

I arrived a little after 7 PM and checked in.

I was impressed to see pets other than dogs and cats, such as lizards.

I was able to see the doctor around 8 PM.

Even after entering the examination room, I had to wait a little before the doctor arrived.

The doctor was young.

The examination itself was over quickly, but I wasn't called for a long time.

When I went to ask, they said they would check, and after waiting, I was called in soon after, received the medicine, and paid.

I think they forgot to call me.


In the end, the hamster's health didn't improve.

However, I have no regrets because I took him to the vet one last time.

I would like to take him again, but I hope the waiting time for appointments will be shorter.

It was heartbreaking to watch my beloved cat's condition worsen, and I wanted to do everything I could for her, so I sought a second opinion.

My cat was a senior and there was nothing more that could be done, but after Dr. Murai examined her, she purred for the first time in a long time. Even just for that moment, I felt so relieved that I was overjoyed, to the point of tears.

She passed away about two weeks later, but I'm so glad I took her to see the doctor.

Thank you.

After receiving a shoddy examination at a certain Osaka Animal Medical Center in Sakura〇, we've been going to Dr. Murai for treatment. When we first came, our pet was in a terrible state, but now it's completely recovered.

It was diagnosed as Cushing's syndrome, then worsened and developed calcification, and although it's still in the treatment stage, it's getting better, and our whole family is overjoyed.

The grooming salon staff and the doctor are very supportive and kind, and we appreciate their words of encouragement. However, the reception staff seem cold. One person even told me to be careful when I called to say I would be late...

I work and come every week after work, so I apologize for being late, but I do try to arrive within the scheduled time.

I don't know why I feel this way, but this lingering feeling of unease has made me give it 4 stars instead of 5.

My beloved dog had surgery for a fracture and was hospitalized for a week.

Dr. Murai explained everything very clearly and carefully, and treated my dog ​​gently, so I was able to entrust my dog ​​to him with complete confidence! He also gave me an estimate of the costs beforehand, which was reassuring.

After consulting with the doctor, it was decided that direct visits were not necessary, so the nurses showed me videos taken on a tablet every day. The nurses and reception staff were all very kind!

I had previously taken my dog ​​to the attached grooming salon, and the groomer there was also very kind; my dog ​​was always happy to see her face!

I would like to continue entrusting my dog ​​to this doctor and staff in the future.

Thank you so much for everything!

He's a small, senior dog.

He had been going to his regular veterinarian for many years, but on the night of January 1st, his condition suddenly worsened. His regular doctor was closed for the New Year holidays, and I was worried that he might die the next day if he continued as he was. I searched for a veterinarian who could examine him, and although I found several clinics, I left work early to go to Dr. Murai's. Of the several options, choosing Dr. Murai was the right choice.

He went to the vet every day over the New Year holidays. Dr. Murai explained the symptoms and necessary treatment, and only began treatment after obtaining my consent. I explained that it was far from my home, the roads would be congested after the New Year holidays, and it might be difficult to come to Dr. Murai's clinic during his office hours after work. He suggested that I have my regular veterinarian examine him. He said he didn't mind using my house if his condition worsened during his regular doctor's holidays. However, after visiting the vet a few times, I decided I wanted Dr. Murai to examine him, even though it was far away, and so I have been using his services ever since.
He's a senior so he's a bit on the wane, but he's started eating and walking around the house. 
I'm really grateful. Thank you.
It was really good ✨ The teacher was kind and taught me carefully.

This was my first time owning a dog, and my first time at a veterinary clinic. Based on reviews and the doctor's experience, I decided to go here.

The doctor is much more humble, polite, and thorough than those at human hospitals. He patiently explained everything to me, a complete novice, making sure I understood.

I felt a level of kindness and consideration that went beyond just the examination.

Before any examination or test, he always gives me an estimated cost and confirms it with me.

Regarding symptoms, I think the doctor tends to consider the worst-case scenario. Therefore, he doesn't overlook even my smallest comments and conducts thorough examinations, which means the fees are a little higher (he tells me the cost beforehand), but since it's about my precious family member, I always feel relieved and at ease when I go home.

He explains everything carefully, step by step.

The cost can be a bit higher if multiple tests are needed, but I think he's a very trustworthy doctor. He takes plenty of time with each patient, and since appointments are available, there's hardly any waiting time in the clinic.
They seem to be short-staffed, as they often don't answer the phone these days.

The heart medication prescribed by my regular veterinarian at another hospital didn't suit my pet, and I wasn't satisfied with their treatment, so I went to see Dr. Murai as a last resort.

For several days, my pet had trouble sleeping due to itching and hair loss, but the night after Dr. Murai examined him, the itching seemed to subside, and he slept soundly for the first time in a long time.

Also, coincidentally, a cardiologist started coming for regular checkups, so I can continue heart treatment with peace of mind, and I'm glad I switched hospitals.

This hospital is very helpful because even if I need to see my pet urgently, I can make an appointment using PetPass without having to go to the hospital in person, and I only need to go when my turn is approaching. I can also use iPet insurance, which is a great help.

My Syrian Greek tortoise had cold symptoms, and since Anicom pet insurance was applicable, and I also read reviews, I decided to take her to Murai Animal Hospital.

When I first called, they were very kind and explained in detail how to make a reservation using their "PetPASS" app, which I was able to do while listening and operating the app.

One helpful review I read was about a chipmunk that had pneumonia and recovered after receiving suction and IV fluids, similar to what you'd see at an ENT clinic.

On the first day, after the examination and treatment, when the doctor returned "Seran" to my hands, she was moving her limbs vigorously, her eyes were bright, and when I put her down for a moment, she walked briskly and quickly.

The next morning, she ate her food with gusto, gobbling it down.

I was so happy! When I got home, I said, "You really did so well, thank you," and put her back in her cage. She acted as if nothing had happened, scratching at the bottom of the cage, burrowing into the pet sheet, and falling asleep peacefully.

As I listened to the explanation while looking at the X-rays, I was stunned to hear that Seran had pneumonia. The doctor, however, said to me, "You're this little one's mother!" (a kind of encouragement?).

His words made me snap back to reality, and I think that's why I was able to say, "Please take care of Seran," and bring her in for examination and treatment.

At the follow-up appointment a week later, after visiting every other day, the doctor said, "She did so well, she's all better now."

I send my heartfelt gratitude and thanks to the doctor and nurses at Murai Animal Hospital.

Dr. Murai is a truly skilled individual.

The nurses and staff are incredibly kind and caring.

Currently, Seran eats well, roams freely and briskly in the kitchen, and enjoys wandering around the room, scattering clover, dandelions, and other plants that I've gathered from the park.

She weighs 131g—quite heavy!

Please continue to take good care of Seran.

Since my family doesn't speak, it's important that the doctor is trustworthy.
Since we have a breed of dog that is sensitive to heat, the appointment system means we can predict the wait time and reduces the burden on my family. …

I was diagnosed with a cervical hernia at another hospital, but I thought something was wrong, so I investigated and went to a hospital close to where I could avoid putting stress on my cat. First, I checked the cat's condition and they …

After receiving an explanation about the surgery at another hospital, I felt uneasy about having the surgery there...💧 I wasn't convinced, and I wondered if there might be other surgical options. So I searched for other hospitals and came …

Your hospital was extremely kind to my beloved dog.
My dog ​​had been going to another hospital, but when I was closed, he suddenly took a turn for the worse, so I rushed him here. …

Thank you for your continued support.
Even though he is busy with many patients, he examines our pets carefully and explains all family members' questions in detail. …
